reading: President Trump made a new announcement.
The United States will reduce its military drills with South Korea.
South Korea stayed out of the Iran war.
This was one reason for the President's choice.
President Trump said he has a very good relationship with North Korea's leader.
It is another reason for the change.
The decision is to downsize these exercises.
This means the joint training will become smaller.
The countries will still work together, but less often.

vocabulary.definition: To make something smaller or less.
Practice exercises for soldiers and armies.
When two people or countries are good friends.
To give a reason for something or to mention something.
To intentionally avoid becoming involved in a situation or conflict.

entries.ja: 何かをより小さくしたり、少なくしたりすること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것을 더 작게 만들거나 수량을 줄이는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 使某物变得更小或更少。
entries.es: Hacer que algo sea más pequeño o menos.
entries.pt-BR: Tornar algo menor ou em menor quantidade.

entries.ja: 兵士や軍隊のための訓練演習。
entries.zh-Hans: 士兵和军队的训练演习。
entries.es: Ejercicios de práctica para soldados y ejércitos.
entries.pt-BR: Exercícios de prática para soldados e exércitos.

entries.ja: 二人の人や二つの国が良い友人である状態。
entries.ko: 두 사람이나 두 국가가 좋은 친구인 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 当两个人或国家之间是好朋友时。
entries.es: Cuando dos personas o países son buenos amigos.
entries.pt-BR: Quando duas pessoas ou países são bons amigos.

entries.ja: 何かの理由を述べたり、何かを挙げたりすること。
entries.ko: 어떤 일에 대한 이유를 대거나 어떤 것을 언급하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 为一个事物给出理由或提及某个事物。
entries.es: Dar una razón para algo o mencionar algo.
entries.pt-BR: Dar uma razão para algo ou mencionar algo.

entries.ja: 何かをより小さくすること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것을 더 작게 만드는 것.

entries.ja: 状況や対立に関わらないように意図的に避けること。
entries.ko: 어떤 상황이나 분쟁에 의도적으로 휘말리지 않는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 故意避免卷入某种情况或冲突。
entries.es: Evitar intencionadamente involucrarse en una situación o conflicto.
entries.pt-BR: Evitar intencionalmente se envolver em uma situação ou conflito.
